narrative: Hormuz escalation headlines dominate the weekend after an oil tanker ignited from naval mines, setting up crude-driven support for CAD and safe-haven USD demand at the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1166, with downside risk persisting as the Fed-ECB +150bp OIS carry advantage and Fitch's French downgrade weigh. Meanwhile, USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.3973; elevated oil prices may cushion CAD downside against broad dollar strength ahead of Tuesday's RBA decision.
